sentences.text:
=
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE RAJIV ROY

2. The present petition has been preferred for issuance of an appropriate writ commanding upon the respondents concerned to give the appropriate and enhanced the compensation amount to the petitioners for acquiring the landed property of the petitioners, within the District of Muzaffarpur for the purpose of doubling Railway Line Project, Sugauli Sigauli within Village Muzaffarpur to GaushiChapara, Police Station-Kanti, Thana No. 57, Anchal-Kanti, District- Muzaffarpur pursuant to the Notification under Section 11(1) of Land Acquisition Act 20/2013 published in Daily Hindi Newspaper 'Hindustan' on 2nd June, 2022
and apparently some plots of the petitioners have been acquired for the said purpose. Patna High Court CWJC No.2417 of 2024(2) dt.16-05-2024 3. Let the respondent nos. 2 and 3 file counter affidavit.

(Rajiv Roy, J) kiran/-
